title: GPU coverage velocity and commit ladder
summary: Working planning sheet to translate current burn and utilization signals into a five-tranche procurement ladder by SKU and region. Purpose is to provide procurement and infra leads a clear cadence (weeks 0-24) that balances lead-time variability, regional buffer targets, and cost-effective hedging. Draft for review before we lock Q1 reserved commitments.

formulas_and_assumptions: monthly_burn_est = (estimated_active_instances * avg_tokens_per_min * avg_minutes_per_day * 30) approximated and normalized to GPU-equivalent-hours
buffer_weeks = ceil(leadtime_days / 7) + region-specific safety (us-west-2 = -1 week because local rebalancing capability)
utilization_pct is 30-day rolling average of GPU utilization weighted by latency-sensitive buckets
commit_tranche_spacing: smallest tranche every 4 weeks for flexibility, larger tranches at 8-12 week spacing depending on SKU lead time
lead time measurements combine vendor quoted lead + customs & regional rack provisioning (additive)
risk_matrix: supplier_shortage|High|Severe|Keep 14-week hedge and access to secondary suppliers
logistics_delay_eu|Medium|High|Increase local buffer in eu-west-1 by 2 weeks; prioritize regional pre-staging
rapid_growth_event|Medium|High|Auto-burst to dedicated pool in select regions and expedite tranche execution
hardware_obsolescence|Low|Medium|schedule staggered replacements over 12 months; avoid single-sku dependence
notes: Notes to self and procurement: 1) Validate H100 supplier queue position before confirming tranche-2; 2) Explore convertible purchase options (capex -> opex) for APAC to reduce customs exposure; 3) Cross-team ask: SRE to provide 2-week rolling rebalancing capacity numbers to refine regional buffer heuristics; 4) Consider small monthly spot-topups to smooth utilization instead of large, infrequent bulk orders.
